$comment: Which recording a page section shows, by ROLE (krizaka-internal#4635, the pattern of verikora#914; fields of the asset registry of krizaka-internal#4482: location, owner, origin, uses). `id` is a clip of src/core/clips/clips.ts (its words: translations.clips.ts). A page asks « the media of role R on page P » and gets the entries listed here that may be shown: a test recording, or anything else only with `founderYes`. An entry with `blocked` is never shown on the public export, and says why. Adding a use shows it, with no code change. Read by src/features/landing/utils/section-media.ts.

media.reason: One action and its result: a sentence typed, the run followed, the image with its model and generation time.
Every result is kept: the jobs of the last days, by kind, each with its state.
